title: Make the styling for minimized Tasks more pronounced
line: Minimized windows now show a dimmed icon in the Task Manager, so they are easy to tell apart from open ones.
explanation: The Task Manager marks a minimized task only by switching its frame to the Plasma theme's "minimized" prefix. In Breeze that frame is barely visible (lower opacity than the normal frame), so in icons-only mode a minimized window looks almost the same as a normal one, well below accessibility contrast guidelines. The task's "minimized" state now also draws the app icon at 60% opacity; badges, the label text and the frame are unchanged, and the icon returns to full opacity as soon as the window is restored.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: dim the icons of minimized tasks

Minimized tasks were only told apart by the theme's "minimized" frame,
which in Breeze is so faint that they look just like normal ones. Their
icons are now drawn at reduced opacity, making the state easy to spot.

BUG: 433196

From d49fefbacd9aac902a2bd29ad1fda96ad5f23bea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 17:55:07 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: dim the icons of minimized tasks

Minimized tasks were only told apart by the theme's "minimized" frame,
which in Breeze is so faint that they look just like normal ones. Their
icons are now drawn at reduced opacity, making the state easy to spot.

BUG: 433196
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..5ff582b9eb 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -671,6 +671,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
 
             PropertyChanges {
                 frame.basePrefix: "minimized"
+                icon.opacity: 0.6
             }
         },
         State {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Dolphin (open), Konsole (minimized), System Settings (active): the minimized Konsole task is almost indistinguishable
Same windows with the fix: the minimized Konsole icon is dimmed

review.text: Setting icon.opacity: 0.6 in Task.qml's minimized State makes minimized tasks unmistakably distinct from both open windows and pinned launchers across all Plasma themes, matching the approach suggested by Nate on the bug report. Targeting icon directly keeps the text label, unread badges, audio indicators, and attention states at full opacity, uses standard Qt 6 PropertyChanges syntax matching the rest of Task.qml, and automatically restores full opacity when leaving the minimized state. The diff, commit message, and before/after comparison are clean and ready for MR.
